valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E on the Tokyo ordinary share (ADR ratio 1 ADR = 1 ordinary share). FY2027 (year to Mar 2028) EPS viewed at the Nov 2027 target date, converted at 160 JPY/USD (USD/JPY about 160 on 13 Nov 2026 per MUFG Research). Shares about 5.84B (roic.ai, 30 Sep 2026); FY2026 guided net income JPY 1.33T gives EPS about JPY 228. Net income and share count for FY2027 are my assumptions, not company guidance.

bear.driver: Yen strengthens, gaming margin and sensor demand soften, net income about JPY 1.15T
bear.assumption: EPS JPY 200 at 15x = JPY 3,000 at 160 JPY/USD

base.driver: Gaming OI about JPY 700B and Pictures JPY 200B sustained, FY2026 net income guide JPY 1.33T grows to about JPY 1.45T with buybacks
base.assumption: EPS JPY 252 at 19x = JPY 4,788 at 160 JPY/USD

bull.driver: Record sensor and gaming profit, weak yen, net income about JPY 1.65T
bull.assumption: EPS JPY 285 at 22x = JPY 6,270 at 160 JPY/USD

valuation.implied_by_close: At base EPS JPY 252 the close ($27.07 = JPY 4,331) implies 17.2x; the Bernstein target of $26 implies 16.5x or EPS about JPY 228 at 19x
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $1.58 (5.8 pp); 10 JPY of USD/JPY moves it by about $1.8
valuation.watch_metric: Game & Network Services and Imaging & Sensing operating income against the JPY 700B gaming full-year outlook, plus USD/JPY

analyst_notes: Only one named analyst with a dated, sourced call was found (Bernstein, David Dai, Market Perform, target raised to $26 from $23 on 5 Nov 2026 after the profit forecast raise); the sample is not representative. Published consensus is Hold with about $26 per MarketBeat, below the base case mainly through a lower multiple (about 16.5x vs 19x) at similar EPS. Targets for other brokers were undated or unverifiable and were left out.

sources.label: Sony Q2 FY2026 forecast raise
sources.supports: FY2026 sales, OI, net income guidance, dividend JPY 35
